Data Entry Clerk
Location: Columbus, OH

Compensation includes a $20,000 sign-on bonus for candidates who start before year end, and a

Area: Downtown

- Reliable attendance
- High school diploma
- Experience with Salesforce

Our stack:
- Salesforce
